title: pleiotaenia
intro: Pleiotaenia, commonly known as Himalayan Pleiotaxis, is a genus of flowering plants in the family Asteraceae. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties and is used in traditional medicine to treat various ailments. The health benefits of Pleiotaxis include anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, which help to reduce pain and inflammation, as well as fight off infections. The bioactive constituents of the plant include sesquiterpene lactones, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which exhibit therapeutic actions such as antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial activities.
